:::writing{variant="social_post" id="48271"}
Somewhere between med spa founder, chaos coordinator, podcast host, strategist, therapist, visionary, coffee addict, and “don’t text me before caffeine” lives… me. 🤣

This little sketchbook feels like someone took every layer of who I am and threw it onto paper all at once. The polished side. The exhausted side. The dreaming side. The woman rebuilding herself while building businesses, leading teams, raising humans, chasing purpose, and somehow still remembering to help everyone else feel beautiful too.

What I love most is that it captured the energy behind everything:
✨ Big vision
✨ High standards
✨ Soft heart
✨ Loud ambition
✨ Faith over fear
✨ Luxury mixed with authenticity
✨ Grace mixed with grit

Not gonna lie… the “running on caffeine, vision & obsessive standards” part felt a little too accurate. 😂

But honestly, this is what entrepreneurship feels like sometimes:
A messy sketchbook of ideas, pressure, creativity, resilience, leadership, healing, humor, and purpose all layered together.

And somehow… it becomes art anyway. 🤍
:::
